notes.title: Patch v0.5.8
notes.notes: [p]A small patch has arrived! 🌱[/p][p][/p][p]This update fixes an issue with save files corrupting. I'm truly sorry to those who lost progress. Also adds some new furnitures and decoration.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Content[/b][/h3][p][b]New furnitures and decoration:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Walkway/Path Lights in front of store[/p][/*][*][p]Floor Signs (Fruits, Flowers, Veggies, Tools, Plants)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Fixes & Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed bug where the game would not save when very large numerical values couldn’t be converted to integers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where NPCs could walk through the Large Fruit Stand.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where holding a box from an empty box rack caused players to drift.[/p][/*][*][p]Added error checking during save: if an error occurs, the game will no longer overwrite your save file with corrupted data.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased rotating save backups from 5 to 10.[/p][/*][*][p]Check if the tutorial is completed and unlock achievement (for players who completed tutorial in the demo)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.5.4
notes.notes:
Changes:
* at the start of each day check if player has unlocked # of days played achievements
* add UI option to hide tutorial/goals panel
* add UI option to hide input prompts

If you’re experiencing consistent issues with gardeners or stockers getting stuck and you want to help, please email your save file (save_0.json, save_1.json or save_2.json) and Player.log to help@rasm.dev. You can find them here:

C:\Users\%USERNAME%\AppData\LocalLow\RobotAssembly\PlantNurserySimulator

I apologize for the inconvenience, fixing this is my top priority right now.

notes.title: Patch v0.5.2
notes.notes:
[p]Fixed bug where stockers were not returning boxes/crates to storage after restocking shelves. Causing them to hold multiplex boxes/crates at once and causing inventory to go missing.

Apologies for any inconvenience.[/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.5.1
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone!  First off we apologize for the delay in getting this patch out, and thank you to everyone for your feedback and support. This patch features a new license with Gardening Tools, a new bigger fruit shelf, and a toggle to disable stockers/gardeners from using storage racks that have empty tags.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Content[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added new [b]Gardening Tools License[/b], which includes:[/p][list][*][p]Hand Rake[/p][/*][*][p]Hand Fork[/p][/*][*][p]Lime Sulfur[/p][/*][*][p]Neem Oil[/p][/*][*][p]Trowel[/p][/*][*][p]Plastic Watering Can[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added new [b]Fruit Shelf[/b] for expanded produce display options.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New toggle to prevent stockers from storing boxes in untagged and empty shelves.[/p][/*][*][p]New toggle to prevent gardeners from storing boxes in untagged and empty shelves.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Reduced Halfway Hero achievement from [b]500 Days[/b] to [b]250 Days[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Binoculars Trinket now unlocks earlier (Level 25).[/p][/*][*][p]Sundial Trinket now unlocks earlier (Level 33).[/p][/*][*][p]Gardeners now take seeds from storage shelves before store shelves.[/p][/*][*][p]Gardeners will skip benches they cannot reach instead of getting stuck.[/p][/*][*][p]More consistent gardeners positioning when seeding and harvesting.[/p][/*][*][p]Gardeners only harvest pots assigned to a gardening benches.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added missing Gardener localization for “Can’t find empty box racks.”[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Half Storage Rack width so it aligns correctly with other racks.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where purchasing store, greenhouse, or storage expansions could cause money to go missing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tooltip and hover text formatting issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where gardeners holding empty boxes from harvesting could be placed incorrectly on storage racks.[/p][/*][/list][p]
Thanks again for your support! The next patch will focus on improving Stocker efficiency and overall game performance. We’ll also be releasing a roadmap soon so you can see what’s ahead! Stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.5.0 (Gardener Update!)
notes.notes: [p]We heard you loud and clear! Gardening was getting too click-heavy and time-consuming. This patch introduces [b]Gardeners[/b] to help automate your nursery, plus 3 new [b]trinkets[/b] to further streamline your workflow.[/p][p][/p][h2]🌱 New Feature: Gardeners[/h2][p]You can now [b]hire up to 6 gardeners[/b] to assist with two key tasks: [b]Harvesting Crops[/b] and [b]Seeding Pots[/b].[/p][h3]Gardener Harvesting:[/h3][list][*][p]Gardeners harvest [b]at the start of each day[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]There must be [b]Empty Box Racks with available boxes[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Gardeners will harvest crops and fill boxes.[/p][/*][*][p]Once full, they’ll store the boxes in [b]Storage Racks[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gardener Seeding:[/h3][list][*][p]After harvesting, gardeners begin seeding.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Requirements:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Gardening benches must be marked with a crop type.[/p][list][*][p]Plant one seed from your chosen seedbox into a pot to mark the bench. A tag will display the crop type.[/p][/*][*][p]Click the tag to clear.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Shelves stocked with seed boxes must be available. (the ones customers shop from)[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p]Gardeners grab seed boxes and seed pots until finished or the seed box is empty.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gardener Synergies with Trinkets:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Acorn:[/b] XP from harvesting.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Trophy:[/b] XP from seeding.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stone Lantern:[/b] Double harvest from large pots.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sundial:[/b] Double seed box quantity.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🔮 New Trinkets[/h2][p]Three new trinkets added in this patch:[/p][list][*][p][b]Wood Crate:[/b] Instantly sell crops at 90% of retail value.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Binoculars:[/b] When holding a box and its object, highlight matching shelf and storage rack.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Trowel:[/b] Hold mouse button to seed, soil, fertilize, and harvest pots in a [b]single swipe[/b]—no more clicking![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🛠️ Quality of Life Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Storage Racks can now be purchased [b]before unlocking storage rooms[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Closed Cash Registers now persist across days[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Simplify tree models to improve performance for lower end devices.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thank you all for your amazing support, kind words, and thoughtful feedback. It truly means the world to us and keeps us going! This update should help reduce the busywork and keep your nursery running smoothly. 🌿[/p][p]Enjoy and stay tuned for more updates![/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.4.6
notes.notes: [p]🐛 [b]Bugfixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where boxes could become non-interactable or appear frozen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed customers occasionally getting stuck at the cash register[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where boxes were incorrectly shelved while harvesting crops if a storage rack was behind them[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed input prompt incorrectly showing when switching between controller and keyboard/mouse while not interacting with anything[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed items being charged only once (not by quantity) when using the "Ship in Large Boxes" option[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch v0.4.5
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone![/p][p]We’re excited to share a new patch packed with useful tools, quality-of-life improvements, and bug fixes. Thank you again for all your feedback and support. It’s been a huge help as we continue building the game together.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🆕 New Features[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Stats App[/b] added to the tablet:[/p][list][*][p][b]Sales tab[/b]: view checkouts, sales, expenses, and a cash flow chart[/p][/*][*][p][b]Customers tab[/b]: displays all customer feedback received during the day[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Stock tracking improvements[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]New [b]Stock[/b] column in the Pricing app[/p][/*][*][p]Scanner now shows stock count when hovering over price tags[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Items shipped in [b]Large Boxes[/b] now arrive fully stocked[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]Box Rack[/b] for storing empty boxes[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stockers[/b] now place empty boxes on the rack instead of throwing them away[/p][/*][*][p]Input prompts now update based on whether you’re using a controller or mouse/keyboard[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]lights to greenhouses[/b] for better visibility in the evening[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]audio setting[/b] to toggle scanner sound effects[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]⚙️ Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improved Dolly stability when carrying fruit crates[/p][/*][*][p]Boxes spawned with the scanner now stack neatly to prevent collision issues and make them reachable for stockers[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]🐛 Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed: Unable to remove individual boxes from the Dolly in some cases[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed: Invisible walls caused by leftover colliders when moving storage racks[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed: “Press Enter to End Day” prompt no longer overlaps with cash register total in certain languages[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed: Tablet will now reset its rotation automatically if it gets flipped[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed: If a save file is corrupted, the game now shows an error message with a link to help:[/p][p][url="https://rasm.dev/plant-sim/help"]https://rasm.dev/plant-sim/help[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]
The next update will focus on making gardening easier and more automated. Now that the empty box rack is in place, we’re planning to add [b]Gardeners[/b] and new [b]trinkets[/b] for quality-of-life improvements like [b]holding down to seed or harvest[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you’ve been having a great summer and enjoy everything in this new patch! 🌞
[/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.4.4
notes.notes: [p]This update brings improvements to stocker behavior, they should now feel great and act much more reliably! Thank you to everyone who sent in bug reports and for your patience while we worked on these fixes. Alongside the bugfixes, we’ve added some quality-of-life improvements to make your nursery run even smoother.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🐛 Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Restless Stockers[/b][/p][p]Fixed a bug where stockers would pace back and forth between storage racks after completing all tasks at the end of the day.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dragonfly Trinket & EU Currency[/b][/p][p]The Dragonfly trinket (auto-fills the card reader) now works properly for players using European currency formats.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]🌿 Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Transfer items between boxes on storage racks[/b][/p][p]You can now transfer items from the box you're holding to boxes on storage racks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Master Stocker Toggle[/b][/p][p]Added a single on/off switch to control all stockers at once.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Plant Placement[/b][/p][p]Fixed collisions preventing shelves from being placed back to back when they contained large plants.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bonsai Tree Trinket Toggle[/b][/p][p]You can now toggle the effects of the Bonsai Tree trinket on or off from the trinket shop. The Bonsai Tree made customers purchase 2 additional crops.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for continuing to support Plant Nursery Simulator 💚. We couldn't have made this game better without you![/p][p][/p][p][b]P.S.[/b] Huge thanks to Steam user [b]sfrenchie[/b] for helping track down the stocker bug![/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.4.0
notes.notes: [p]This update focuses on [b]partial controller support[/b], improved stocker behavior, and a bunch of quality-of-life improvements across the board![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Partial Controller Support (Steam Deck, Xbox, PlayStation, Switch)[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We’ve introduced [b]partial controller support[/b] for a smoother experience, especially for Steam Deck players![/p][list][*][p]Supports gameplay controls using a controller[/p][/*][*][p]Menus and UI still require a mouse, touchscreen, or trackpad[/p][/*][*][p]Input prompts automatically switch to your active device[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]We know full controller support is important, but instead of waiting for everything, we wanted to get something out now. This should help make Steam Deck play much more comfortable for now![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Stocker Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Stockers now prioritize shelves with the lowest item counts[/p][/*][*][p]Stockers now choose boxes from storage with the lowest quantities first[/p][/*][*][p]Pick up boxes they dropped at the start of the next day[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug with multiple stockers trying to restock the same shelf[/p][/*][*][p]Added 6 more stockers available for late-game hiring[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]New Features & Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Half Width Storage Rack[/p][/*][*][p]Shopping Cart Upgrades:[/p][list][*][p]Max cart items increased to 20[/p][/*][*][p]Cart icon now displays total quantity[/p][/*][*][p]Clicking “Add to Cart” multiple times increases quantity[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Furniture Throwout Improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Furniture now gives a refund when thrown manually[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Store Lighting Adjustments:[/p][list][*][p]Brighter store lighting[/p][/*][*][p]Lights turn off in the morning and back on after 6 PM[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Item Name Tooltips:[/p][list][*][p]Hovering over shelf/storage tags now shows the item name[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Crop Size Tweaks:[/p][list][*][p]Honeydew and melons made smaller to better fit on shelves and in boxes[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Improved Resource Bar:[/p][list][*][p]Held boxes and crates now show updated item name in the resource bar when swapping items[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Input Layout for Controller and Mouse and Keyboard:[/p][list][*][p]Added a map of keybindings for controller and keyboard in settings menu[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Reset Player Button:[/p][list][*][p]New option to Desktop”[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]New Trinkets[/b][/p][list][*][p]Boat: Unlocks a master sprinkler valve to toggle all sprinklers at once[/p][/*][*][p]Sundial: Doubles the crops[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed bug where character collider would widen after crouching[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed navmesh issue with 4L Half Shelf when rotated[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed NPC pathfinding to include the back row of greenhouses[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Store Customization Updates[/b][/p][list][*][p]Wood oak awning now matches notes.title: Patch v0.3.2
notes.notes:
[p]Thanks again for all your feedback! This update brings a mix of important bug fixes, QoL improvements, and a few tweaks to make the experience smoother and more intuitive.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🐛 Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the player gets slightly pushed back when placing a box on a storage rack.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed stockers getting stuck while trying to restock shelves.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed stockers attempting to restock shelves with the wrong item after the player changes the shelf’s assigned item type.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed double-click issues when two wooden crates are stacked (e.g., item pickup + transfer triggering together).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rare issue where players could fall through the floor.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]⚙️ Quality of Life[/b][/p][list][*][p]The [b]“Ship in Large Box”[/b] setting now persists between days and also applies to items bought using the handheld scanner.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]toggle sprint[/b] option in the settings menu.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now [b]turn stockers on or off[/b] via the computer.[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]backup button[/b] has been added to skip to the next day if the game gets stuck at 7:00 PM.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Level Up popup[/b] is now smaller and appears higher on the screen, so it blocks less.[/p][/*][*][p]Moved the [b]resource bar[/b] slightly upward to avoid overlapping the exit day prompt.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted seed visuals: [b]small pot seeds are now orange[/b] and [b]large pot seeds are black[/b] for easier identification. A tip about this was added to the Gardening Book.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]🛠️ Visual & UI Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Held [b]boxes and crates[/b] now appear more consistently aligned in the player’s hands.[/p][/*][*][p]Swapped the starting garbage can with a nicer-looking model and you can move it now![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]🏆 Achievements[/b][/p][list][*][p]The [b]“100,000 Checkouts”[/b] achievement has been reduced to [b]25,000 Checkouts[/b], making it more attainable.[/p][/*][/list][p]
We received a lot of feedback and we aim to address it all, thank you for your patience and your support.[/p][p]We’re starting work right away on the [b]next patch[/b], which will include [b]new trinkets[/b] and more [b]QoL improvements[/b]. Stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.3.1
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone! We’ve just released the first patch for [i]Plant Nursery Simulator[/i] with a mix of quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes, and small upgrades based on your feedback.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🆕 New Features[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Rotating Save Backups:[/b] Each save slot now stores up to [b]5 automatic backups[/b] to help protect your progress.[/p][/*][*][p][b]“Apply to All” Button:[/b] You can now apply furniture customizations across all matching items with a single click.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crouching Added:[/b] You can now crouch with [b]"C"[/b] to read bottom signs and labels more easily.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Rooftop Access:[/b] Added a trash bag next to the dumpster and updated colliders so you can now jump onto the roof of the storage rooms.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]⚙️ Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Pricing App Upgrade: [/b]Added buttons to automatically set prices as Retail value[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cashier Efficiency:[/b] Default cashier work speed increased from [b]3s[/b] to [b]2s[/b], and the trinket upgrade increased from [b]1.5s[/b] to [b]2s[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]🐛 Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could pay off loans without enough money.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the [b]Expand App[/b] legend incorrectly showing the storage room as locked.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced level-up popup duration from [b]4 seconds[/b] to [b]2 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]🌼 Thank You![/b][/p][p]A huge thank you to everyone who’s supported the game since launch. Your kind words, bug reports, and suggestions mean the world. This is just the beginning, and we’re excited to keep improving the game with your feedback.[/p]

notes.title: What's Included in the Full Version of Plant Nursery Simulator
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Gardeners![/p][p][/p][p]We’re just [b]one week away[/b] from launch! [b]Plant Nursery Simulator releases on June 16 at 6pm Eastern Time[/b]! 🌱[/p][p][/p][p]We’re also excited to be part of [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] this week. If you’re trying out the demo, welcome! notes.title: Demo v0.1.2 Patch Notes (we also made an IG and TikTok account!)
notes.notes:
💾 Will demo saves work in the full game?
Yes 100%! We’ve had a lot of people ask, and we’re happy to confirm that your progress in the demo will carry over to the full release.
Behind the scenes, we’ve made changes to ensure your saves transfer smoothly with no effort needed on your end.
That said, there will be some changes to prices and order of upgrades in the full version.

📣 We’re on Instagram & TikTok!
Follow us for updates, sneak peeks, and behind-the-scenes dev content:
- IG: [url=https://www.instagram.com/robot_assembly]https://www.instagram.com/robot_assembly[/url]
- TikTok: [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@robot.assembly]https://www.tiktok.com/@robot.assembly[/url]

Liking, sharing, or tagging a friend really helps us out and supports the game’s future development. 🙏

🛠 Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug where customer items were invisible on the cash register table.

✨ Polish & Improvements
- Updated gardening bench colliders to allow placing objects underneath it.
- Objects now snap to 45° angles when being placed.
- Objects now snap to a grid during placement.
- You can now rotate held furniture/objects using the scroll wheel.

notes.title: Demo v0.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
First off, huge thanks to everyone who's played the demo and sent in feedback. This is our biggest update yet, and your input has been invaluable in shaping the game.

[b]⚠️ Heads-up: Furniture Dimensions Changed[/b]
We’ve updated the dimensions of most furniture to support a brand new grid snapping system. This might disrupt your existing layouts, and we’re sorry for the inconvenience but the payoff is worth it.

[b]🆕 New Features[/b]
- Grid Snapping: Furniture now snaps neatly to a placement grid, making it easier than ever to create clean, organized setups. (All furniture models were updated to support this system.)
- Watering Can Refill Station: You can now refill your watering can at the faucet behind the store.
- Garbage Cube Trinket: Unlocks the Junk tab in the Shop, where you can buy trash cans, boxes, and crates.
- Pot Placement Upgrade: You can now place pots directly from the box onto benches in a tidy, grid-aligned layout.
- Veggie License (Demo Bonus): A thank you gift for playing, this new license adds turnip, onion, garlic, lettuce, bok choy, and broccoli.

[b]🐛 Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed an issue where customers got stuck if they couldn’t reach their item.
- ESC key now works properly to exit the computer or cash register.

[b]✨ Polish[/b]
- Goal progression now saves the current step, so you won’t see all the goals cycle every day.
- Added arrow indicators showing the front of furniture while placing it.

Thanks again for playing. We’ll now be focusing fully on building the main game. Stay tuned for a release date, we can’t wait to show you the full experience.

notes.title: Demo v0.0.8 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Thank you once again for playing the demo and sharing your feedback, it’s been incredibly helpful! We’ve been hard at work making improvements, fixing bugs, and adding new features based on your input. Here’s what’s new in this update:

New
- Added Duck Trinket (50% chance of customer paying exact change)
- Added Frog Trinket (plants get watered 2x faster)
- Added ability to throw out furniture (except cash register and computer)

Polishes
- Fixed garbage dumping animation path
- Remove "Test" text on empty shelf price tags
- Adjusted Gardening Book to be held further from the camera
- Add numpad enter during credit card placement
- Prevented day end screen from triggering while text inputs are active

Bugfixes
- Fixed unlimited water bug when holding LMB at 0% water level
- Fixed duplicate items in Gardening and Decor tabs
- Fixed customers getting stuck with empty bags at checkout
- Fixed held trinkets floating in mid-air when saving
- Fixed held objects disappearing when saving
- Fixed Steam showing game as running after quitting
- Fixed incorrect input prompts when picking up items from boxes

We’re also planning a few more updates for the demo to add the following features:
- Grid snapping during furniture placement
- Ability to purchase boxes or crates from the store for cheap
- Purchasing trash cans and moving them
- Placing pots onto the gardening bench, like placing items on shelves
- Watering can refilling

Stay tuned, and as always, let us know what you think!

notes.title: Demo v0.0.7 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
A huge thank you to everyone who has shared feedback and gameplay footage on YouTube! Your insights have been invaluable in helping us refine the game, and it’s been amazing to see players enjoying it.

Improvements & Polish:
- Added numpad and number key support for the credit card reader (from patch v0.0.6).
- Customers now make more realistic cash payments—most use rounded bills, though some still pay with exact change.
- Added sound effects to the End of Day screen for better feedback.
- Pressing Escape now allows you to exit the computer and cash register.
- Added a trash can near the first greenhouse for convenience.
- Watered soil now briefly flashes to provide clearer visual feedback.


Bug Fixes:
- Fixed an issue where customers could get stuck at checkout holding a bag with no items to scan.
